excerpt.quote: **Adequacy: qualified.** The group analysis is a defensible analysis of the supplied fixed inputs. It includes the full 54-person group, treats participant maps as independent effect estimates, uses a common-support mask based on nonzero coverage rather than effect direction, and tests the positive hypothesis with 10,000 participant sign flips and a whole-brain maximum-t correction. The ROI summary is descriptive and the corrected map is the primary inference. The input documentation and report correctly limit the coefficients to the upstream mean-centered, variance-normalized gain regressor; they are not slopes per currency unit. The absence of participant variance maps appropriately prevents precision weighting or auditing the first-level fits.
